scoringSteps.text: Gain LP for each upgraded mount and upgraded weapon owned (value is in the top-left corner of the card).
Gain LP from any Legendary Items owned that provide it (value is in the top-left corner of the card).
Gain 1 LP for every $60 owned (round down).
Lose LP from any Injury cards that cause an end-of-game loss (value is at the bottom of the card).
The most Wanted player gains 3 LP, and each other Wanted player gains 1 LP. If there's a tie for most Wanted, all Wanted players gain 1 LP instead.
Marshal players gain LP based on which row their scoring cube occupies on the Marshal track.
The player furthest along the Gambler track gains 1 LP. In the event of a tie, all tied players gain 1 LP.
Gain LP equal to the total value of all Legendary Tokens gained.
Gain LP from Deeds as instructed on the scoring side of each Deed owned. Destroyed locations (with a ruin token) never count toward scoring.
Apply any end-game scoring or effects from the revealed Title card.
Include the Man In Black in the Final Tally. If he ties for the highest LP, the Man In Black wins the tie.

tiebreakers.text: The player with the most LP wins.
Still tied? The tied player with the most Marshal or Wanted points wins.
Still tied? The tied player with the most gold nuggets wins.
Still tied? The tied player with the fewest wounds wins.
Still tied? The tied players share the victory.
